title.original: $τ^2$-Bench: Evaluating Conversational Agents in a Dual-Control Environment
title.zh: $τ^2$ -Bench：在双重控制环境中评估会话代理
title.en: $τ^2$-Bench: Evaluating Conversational Agents in a Dual-Control Environment

inclusion_reason.zh: τ²-Bench 提供共享状态、双侧工具、组合任务生成和终态核验，形成可复用的人机协作 Agent 测试床。
inclusion_reason.en: τ²-Bench provides shared state, dual-sided tools, compositional task generation, and outcome verification as a reusable human-agent testbed.

abstract.zh: τ²-Bench 将用户和 AI Agent 都建模为可调用工具、共同改变世界状态的控制者，用双控制环境评测对话协调与任务执行。
abstract.en: τ²-Bench models both the user and AI agent as tool-using controllers of shared state, evaluating conversational coordination and execution in a dual-control environment.

problem.zh: 单控制基准把用户降为被动信息源，无法复现技术支持等场景中 Agent 必须指导用户操作并适应其动作的协作难点。
problem.en: Single-control benchmarks reduce users to passive informants and miss settings such as technical support where agents must guide user actions and adapt to them.

approach.zh: 作者把电信任务形式化为 Dec-POMDP，用原子组件生成可验证任务，并以受工具和可观测状态约束的用户模拟器参与执行。
approach.en: The telecom domain is formalized as a Dec-POMDP, tasks are composed from verifiable atoms, and a user simulator acts through tools under observable-state constraints.

system_design.zh: 环境维护共享动态状态，向 Agent 与用户模拟器暴露不同工具和观测；任务生成器、终态验证器和错误消融共同形成评测闭环。
system_design.en: A shared dynamic state exposes different tools and observations to agent and simulator, coupled with compositional generation, end-state verification, and error ablation.

key_results.zh: 从无用户切换到双控制后性能显著下降，分析将损失分解为推理和沟通/协调错误，证明引导用户是独立难点。
key_results.en: Performance drops markedly from no-user to dual control, and ablations separate reasoning from communication/coordination failures, identifying user guidance as a distinct challenge.

limitations.zh: 主要证据来自合成电信域，用户模拟器即使受状态约束也难覆盖犹豫、误解、越权或策略性人类行为。
limitations.en: Evidence centers on a synthetic telecom domain, and even state-constrained simulators cannot capture hesitation, misunderstanding, unauthorized action, or strategic human behavior.

notes.zh: 上述非空 evaluation 标签仅来自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未给出可安全转录的表格级数值、硬件与集群配置，相关细节仍待全文审计。
notes.en: The non-empty evaluation labels above come only from the official arXiv abstract; it provides no table-level numbers, hardware, or cluster configuration safe to transcribe, so those details await full-text audit.
